g.text: Why the Better-Aligned Spacetimeformer Still Lost
Known neighbors did not need relearning
Transferable discovery: the linear output path
It lowered STF MAE from 18.2950 to 17.0688. Gated STF improved MAPE, but its worse MAE/RMSE made it unsuitable for absolute-residual detection.
A failed challenger still identified the inductive-bias mismatch and produced a module worth transferring.
